name: Yue Bai Xing Dou
source:
"Lunar Glow Stellar Dance" is a love-themed game for all ages, produced by the Chinese girl game brand JROCKSTUDIO.The protagonist, able to see ghosts since childhood, is drawn into non-ordinary events, where he encounters five adorable girls. All mysteries will gradually be unveiled.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2653460]Steam[/url]]
translation:
《月白星斗》是由中国美少女游戏品牌玖石社（JROCKSTUDIO）出品的全年龄恋爱题材游戏。自幼便能看见鬼魂的主人公被卷入一连串非日常怪异事件之中，并在途中邂逅了五位惹人怜爱的少女，重重谜团也将随之逐一揭晓。

[摘自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2653460]Steam[/url]]
